blocks.text: Introduction to Inheritance

Inheritance is a fundamental concept in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) that allows us to create a new class based on an existing class. The new class inherits all the members of the existing class and can also add new members or override the ones inherited from the base class.

In C++, we use the colon (:) symbol to inherit a class. For example, if we want to create a class called 'Car' that inherits from a class called 'Vehicle', we would use the syntax: class Car : public Vehicle {}
